note: Editorially curated research and outreach updates, presented newest first, beginning with Brain Awareness Week on 19 March 2026. Videos use verified YouTube thumbnails; event press links refer to publisher articles. Publications are resolved by bibliography ID.

items.title: Il nero che illumina il cervello | TEDxPavia
items.description: Martina Francesca Rizza and Alberto Arturo Vergani revisit Golgi, Ramón y Cajal and the scientific interpretations that shaped modern neuroscience.

items.title: Dopo il TEDx: intervista a Martina Rizza e Alberto Vergani
items.description: An interview by Chiara Barbati exploring Golgi's curiosity, the human side of scientific research, and why communicating science matters.
items.date_note: Shared by interviewer on 10 October 2026; the TEDx talk took place on 27 May 2026.

items.title: European Researchers’ Night: Modellizzando reti di neuroni
items.description: Public science outreach in Pavia, using computational models and simulations to illustrate how neurons and brain circuits work.
A computational approach that brings together subject-specific brain anatomy and neural dynamics in a digital twin.
A historical profile of Cesare Lombroso for the Pioneers in Neurology series.
A windowed detrending method for correcting extreme capacitive artifacts in TMS-EEG recordings.

items.title: Golgi & Cajal on Stage: 120 anni dal Nobel
items.description: For Brain Awareness Week, Martina Francesca Rizza, Alberto Arturo Vergani and Simona Tritto organized a lecture-performance on the 1906 Nobel Prize, with theatre by Luca Munaretto and music by Renato Caruso.
items.source: Brain Awareness Week · University of Pavia
